parameters.name: Tiro bebê — Filhotinho (teste character)
parameters.description: Tiro, a baby Yorkshire terrier puppy, the exact dog in the supplied south-facing pixel art reference. Small quadruped dog sitting naturally on its hind legs, front paws on the ground, large rounded head, short fluffy fur, folded floppy ears, big shiny black eyes, small black nose, happy open mouth with a little pink tongue. Black and very dark charcoal grey coat across the body, back and top of head; warm caramel tan eyebrows, cheeks, muzzle, chest, paws and inner ears. Preserve the reference identity, markings, proportions, seated pose and cute detailed pixel art style consistently in every rotation. No clothes, no accessories, no background.

reference.reason: Sprite frontal detalhado instalado no jogo; identidade consistente com build/art/tiro_fases/final/puppy_pet.png e a diretriz oficial de puppy em docs/plans/tiro/06_INTERFACE_E_ARTE.md (orelhas caídas, sela preta, caramelo no rosto, peito e patas).
